paragraphs: On Thursday afternoon, Lily and Mia sat in the school library. Teacher Kim opened the pen-pal chat, and Grace was there. Lily wrote the first message.

Lily: Hello, Grace! How are you today? Grace: Hi, Lily! I am very well, and I am a bit tired. Lily: I like your emails very much, and I like your drawings too. Lily: Why are you tired? Grace: I practice the violin every day, and tomorrow is my concert. Lily: Wow! When is it, and where is it? Grace: It is on Friday at three o'clock in our school hall. Grace: My grandmother gave me my violin, and I love it very much.

Lily: Do you play a lot of songs? Grace: I play two songs, a slow one and a fast one. Lily: How many children play in the concert? Grace: Twelve children play, and they are all in my class. Lily: Are you excited? Grace: Yes, but I am as nervous as I am excited. Lily: Do not worry, because your music is lovely.

Grace: Thank you! Today, my class tidies the hall. Lily: What do you do? Grace: I put the chairs in four straight lines. Grace: Ms. Ong is friendly, and she helps us with the stage. Lily: Is the hall big? Grace: It is as big as your school hall, I think. Lily: May I ask you something?

Lily: Teacher Kim and I want to put a photo of your concert on Explorers' Blog. Lily: May I use a photo? Grace: Yes, you may! I will send a photo after the concert. Lily: Thank you, and good luck for tomorrow! Grace: Thanks! I will write to you soon. Lily: Teacher Kim is next to me, and she smiles. Mia: Say hello from me, Lily! Lily: Mia says hello, and she wants to hear your songs.
text.summary: Lily and her pen pal Grace write in the pen-pal chat on Thursday afternoon. Grace tells Lily about her violin concert on Friday, and Lily asks if she may put a photo on the blog.
